title: Keep Composer sort controls truthful
steps: Inspect the loaded Songs list with the Composer column enabled and Title sorted ascending.
Click the Composer column header once and inspect the sort indicator and returned song rows.

video_guide.summary: Click Composer and compare its ascending arrow with the unchanged song rows.

chapters.note: Title has an ascending arrow. The four Composer values are Clara Vale, Ada Rowan, Dorian Lake, and Bruno Reed.
Composer has an ascending arrow, but its values still read Clara Vale, Ada Rowan, Dorian Lake, and Bruno Reed.
The Composer arrow and the same nonalphabetical Composer sequence remain visible.
